_notes: Default gate ceilings for score_batch.py --thresholds. Starting points only: they pass disciplined, edited prose with headroom and fail text that is full of stock AI phrasing. Copy this file next to your content, run the scorer on 20 or more of your own pages, and tune each ceiling to your own corpus. Formatting-density features are listed in _warn_only: they print a warning and never fail the gate, because a gate must never push anyone into stripping headings, lists or bold from a page. Language-tell ceilings still block.
